top_stories.title: IRAN-ESCALATION: US Strikes Iranian Radar Sites Overnight — Hormuz Blockade Intensifies
top_stories.event: Iran launched one-way attack drones toward Strait of Hormuz (Jun 5, 22:10 UTC). US forces shot down 4 drones, then struck Iranian coastal surveillance radar sites in Goruk and on Qeshm Island (Jun 5, 22:54 UTC). Kuwait intercepted 7 ballistic missiles in its airspace (Jun 6). US fighter jets reported over multiple Iraqi cities. Trump claims 'ready to rock' after conflict ends, but also says Hormuz will open quickly when an MoU is signed. House voted 215-208 to halt military action against Iran (symbolic — veto-proof? no). Axios: Trump wants to end war, Netanyahu wants to resume it. Witkoff and Kushner met with nuclear experts for Iran talks.
top_stories.consensus_narrative: War escalation continues with no off-ramp. Overnight US-Iran direct engagement (drones → radar strikes) marks significant escalation. Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed — no ships getting through per Trump. Oil supply disruption is real and sustained. Agricultural crisis building (farmers skipping planting in Thailand, Philippines, Bangladesh, Australia; super El Niño looming).
top_stories.contradiction: House voted to end the war — but symbolic only, Senate must also pass. Trump claims 'final negotiations' yet simultaneously authorizes strikes. Netanyahu wants to resume, Trump wants out — policy incoherence. Witkoff/Kushner nuclear talks signal diplomatic track still alive despite kinetic escalation.
top_stories.bet: LONG oil (USO, XLE, /CL) — escalation guarantees supply premium through Monday open. SHORT equities (/ES, SPY puts, QQQ puts) — risk-off amplification from weekend escalation on top of Friday's -4.68% Nasdaq rout. LONG VIX (/VX futures, UVXY) — vol expansion into Monday. SHORT 10Y+ Treasury bonds (TLT puts) — oil-driven inflation expectations + supply concerns pushing yields higher. Crypto: SHORT BTC — risk-off overwhelms any crypto-specific narrative.
top_stories.benefit: Oil trades gap-up Sunday night/Monday AM. VIX spikes above 30+ if Iran retaliation comes this weekend. Equity index puts print 2-3x on Monday. TLT breaks lower as 30Y yield targets 2007 highs.

top_stories.title: US STOCK MASSACRE: Nasdaq -4.68%, S&P Snaps 9-Week Winning Streak — Worst Week Since Iran War Began
top_stories.event: S&P 500 closed -2.59% for the week, Nasdaq -4.68%, Dow -0.32%. Nasdaq 100 extended intraday decline to 3%. S&P snaps 9-week winning streak. US 30-year yield rose to highest level since 2007. Hot CPI (headline 3.8% Y/Y vs 3.7% est, core 2.8% vs 2.7% est) and PPI data due next week. Trump says stocks should be up on good jobs data and 'big success on Iran.' Friday sell-off intensified into close.
top_stories.consensus_narrative: Risk-off driven by: (1) Iran war no end in sight — Hormuz blockade crushing supply chains, (2) hot inflation data killing rate cut hopes, (3) 30Y yields at 2007 highs sucking risk appetite, (4) Warsh confirmed as Fed chair — rate cuts not coming until October at earliest per Trump. Systematic de-risking ahead of weekend with potential Iran escalation.
top_stories.contradiction: Trump claims big success on Iran and says stocks should rally — but market is pricing the exact opposite. Warsh as Fed chair is hawkish relative to market expectations (Trump says he'll leave cuts to Warsh in October). Jobs data was good (non-farm payrolls) which paradoxically means rates stay higher for longer — market treated as negative.
top_stories.bet: SHORT /ES and /NQ futures for Monday gap-down continuation. SHORT QQQ/LONG VIX. BUY puts on SPY (Jun 12 expiry, 520 strike for max gamma). SHORT IWM (small caps — most exposed to oil/war shock). LONG USO as hedge within portfolio.
top_stories.benefit: Momentum carries into Monday — Friday massacre + weekend Iran escalation = gap down open. VIX likely gaps above 28-30. Put gamma accelerates sell-off below key support levels (S&P 5000). Energy sector (XLE) the only potential outperformer vs broad market.

top_stories.title: BTC CRASH: Approaching 200-Week MA at ~$55K — Record Spot ETF Outflows, Market Cap Drops
top_stories.event: BTC price approaching its 200-week moving average (historically 'global bottom' zone). MarketTwits reports $55k-$50k target area expected by many traders. First week of June saw strongest-ever outflows from spot BTC ETFs. BTC approaching key technical support that has historically marked major bottoms (and 'liquidation cascade' zone). Hyperliquid surpassed Dogecoin to become 10th largest crypto by market cap.
top_stories.consensus_narrative: Risk-off tsunami drowning crypto. Iran war → institutional risk managers pulling from high-beta assets. BTC ETF outflows accelerating — record weekly outflows. 200-week MA at ~$55k is the line in the sand. Below that, technical breakdown targets $42k-$38k. Altcoins getting destroyed even faster.
top_stories.contradiction: Clarity Act passed Senate Banking Committee 15-9 advancing to Senate floor — pro-crypto regulatory framework is progressing. SpaceX IPO massive demand (2x $75B offering) shows risk appetite isn't dead entirely. Hyperliquid flipping DOGE shows capital rotating within crypto. 200-week MA has historically printed generational bottoms (2015, 2018-19, 2022).
top_stories.bet: SHORT BTC perp or Jun 12 puts — momentum is down with no catalyst for reversal. STRATEGIC LONG at 200-week MA zone (~$55k) if tested with volume — historically this is the buy zone. SHORT ETH (beta to BTC but worse). Neutral: Watch for weekend 'relief bounce' from oversold conditions to re-enter shorts.
top_stories.benefit: If 200-week MA breaks: cascading liquidations to $42k. If 200-week MA holds: historic bottom pattern. Best risk-adjusted bet is short into Monday risk-off open, then cover at 200-week MA for potential bounce. ETF outflow data Monday night will be critical.
